system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

You partially enter Urdokai, becoming akin to a spirit yourself.

Until the start of your next turn, you are incorporeal.

  • Attacks without the Magical trait cannot harm you. Attacks with the Magical trait, spells, and Path abilities affect you as normal.

  • You may move through creatures, mundane walls, and barriers, but may not end your turn in another creature's space, and you may not enter warded or sanctified spaces.

This effect It ends early if you become Incapacitated or Dying, or if you take an Action that targets the world or another creature, this effect immediately
